name: dental-website-doctor
description: Assess a dental practice’s website the way a patient uses it: call, book, cost, emergency, the dentist. Collects evidence from the public site and a real phone browser, then judges it against root.site’s dental rubric, with a line for the practice and a line for the developer.

interface.shortDescription: Dental website assessment for dentists and their developers
interface.longDescription: Reviews a dental practice website as a patient would: can I call and book from my phone, is the dentist a real person, what will it cost, what do I do in an emergency. The tools collect evidence (page text, links, forms and where they submit, advertising and session-replay trackers, structured data, and phone-width browser measurements); the assessment applies root.site’s published rubric of what a dental website must get right, including privacy risks like ad pixels on appointment forms and advertising claims state boards police. Each finding says what was observed and whether it is a judgement, with a plain-language line for the practice owner and a concrete fix for the developer. Public pages only; no forms submitted, no accounts, no score.
capabilities: Collect evidence from public dental websites
Check the phone experience in a real browser
Flag ad trackers on patient forms and risky advertising claims
Explain fixes to dentists and to developers
defaultPrompt: What should my web developer fix first on my dental site?
Show me a fictional example assessment.
